dedupe_keys.name: faa air traffic activity data system atads

description: The Air Traffic Activity Data System (ATADS) is the Federal Aviation Administration's database of airport operations published through the FAA's OPSNET web reports. It lets users look up the number of operations, take-offs and landings, at any airport and build ranking reports for groups of airports, by calendar or fiscal year. The FAA updates the data on about the 20th of each month with the previous month's counts. Reports are generated free online; the FAA's guide walks through an operations report for Chicago O'Hare. Caveats: the FAA notes that some data are subject to change, and operations are counts, not flight-level records. ATADS gives airport and national movement volumes for capacity planning and airport network flow studies, alongside the BTS T-100 traffic statistics and the FAA aeronautical data.
name: FAA Air Traffic Activity Data System (ATADS)
